project_title: GTEX Nigeria Launch Plan — Premium Football Club Ownership Console

theme_strategy.rationale: High-density football club management demands deep contrast, immersive arena lighting, and executive boardroom seriousness. Obsidian background (#090D14) with pitch-grass emerald highlights (#10B981) and vibrant neon cyan/gold triggers for live events.

typography.pairing_archetype: The Performance Pro & Tactical Executive (Barlow Condensed Heavy Headings + Crisp Sans Body + JetBrains Mono for Currency/Metrics)

scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tight leading-none uppercase
scale.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-extrabold tracking-tight uppercase
scale.caption_overline: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-emerald-400 font-bold

colors.archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO (Elite Athleticism & Executive Boardroom)
colors.contrast_rules: All text must achieve > 4.5:1 APCA contrast ratio. Explicit text colors set on interactive hover (e.g., hover:bg-emerald-500 hover:text-slate-950). Limits on primary green: used strictly for CTAs, positive momentum, live status, and core metrics.

surface_styles.tracing_beam: Glowing 1px gradient line border for active live matches and high-priority inbox actions.
surface_styles.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-slate-900/80 border border-white/10 shadow-2xl for top header bar and floating owner action drawers.
surface_styles.tactical_grid: Grid borders border-r border-b border-white/5 for information-dense dashboard blocks.

visual_enhancers.micro_textures: Subtle tactical grass pitch grid patterns in background section overlays, 1px sharp inner strokes instead of heavy diffuse drop shadows.

layout_and_grids.marketing_landing: Asymmetric Bento Grid (Mode A Tetris Grid) with high visual impact hero, 30-second ownership clarity card, live world simulator ticker, and quick club creation wizard trigger.
layout_and_grids.dashboard_6_blocks: High Density Grid (Mode B) layout for Owner Control Center:
blocks: 1. My Clubs (Up to 3 clubs, status, league position, value trend, manager mood, multi-club group disclosure)
2. Owner Inbox (Manager meeting requests, player unrest, regen breakthroughs, transfer bids, sponsor offers, competition invites)
3. Today's Decisions (Approve/reject transfer request, facility spend, manager response, enter competition, resolve morale)
4. Live Club Health (Finances, squad depth, morale, injuries, academy output, fan engagement)
5. Competition & Fixtures Rail (Upcoming fixtures, live 2D matches, hosted cups, friend rivalries)
6. Club Economy Snapshot (Cash, revenue streams, pending payouts, gifts received, 70/30 sponsor split, Club Support Units)

key_features_and_views: Landing Page (30-second ownership pitch, feature highlights, Nigeria Paystack readiness, active world status)
First-Club Activation Onboarding Wizard (Club Identity -> Sign starting XI within budget -> Appoint manager from 3 candidates -> Enter first league/cup)
My Clubs (Multi-club group ownership view, facility upgrades, related-party transfer tracking)
Market & Transfers (Player list with filter/search, fair-value band validator for same-owner transfers)

2D Match Center (Live pitch visualizer with commentary feed, momentum bar, mentality toggle [Defensive/Balanced/Attacking], manager reactions, football-native gift rail [Golden Boot, Floodlights, Stadium Roar])
Manager & Squad (Manager trait sheet: tactical, transfer pref, temperament, ambition, loyalty, discipline; squad table with morale & contract)
Academy & Regens (Regen personality matrix: ambition, marketability, growth drivers, transfer pressure)

Unified Finance & Ledger (Naira deposit via Paystack simulator, GTEX Coin vs Fan Coin breakdown, balances labeled: withdrawable / non-withdrawable / earned / deposited / promotional / pending review, 70/30 sponsor split, Club Support Units)
Inbox & Decisions (Consequence-driven notifications with What/Why/Next Owner Action)
Admin Review Queue (Withdrawal audits, integrity flags, payout holds)

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Interactive buttons expand slightly with subtle shadow glow, cards illuminate border on hover.
motion_and_interactions.match_momentum: Animated momentum bar in 2D Match Center pulsing live pitch updates every few seconds.
motion_and_interactions.stagger_entrances: Framer motion staggered fade-in for inbox items and squad player rows.

accessibility.apca_contrast: Ensure white/bright emerald text against dark slate background.
accessibility.aria_labels: All interactive elements, match triggers, and modal actions have explicit aria-labels and data-testid attributes.

testing_requirements.data_testid_rule: MUST include data-testid attribute on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, filter dropdowns, action cards, modal triggers) using kebab-case role naming (e.g., data-testid='approve-transfer-button', data-testid='owner-inbox-tab').

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Build the frontend as a React 19 app with Tailwind CSS and lucide-react icons.
2. Ensure the top navigation includes Home/Owner Control Center, My Clubs, Market & Transfers, Competitions, Manager & Squad, Academy/Regens, Finance, Inbox, and Admin Queue toggle.
3. On first load, provide a high-converting Landing Page with 30-second ownership value proposition and 'Activate My First Club' wizard trigger.
4. Implement the 6 distinct dashboard blocks in Owner Control Center with data density, consequence clarity, and actionable decision modals.
5. Provide 2D Match Center with dynamic commentary tick, pitch visualizer, momentum bar, mentality controller, and Football-Native Gifting Rail (Golden Boot, Floodlights, Stadium Roar).
6. Include Paystack Naira deposit simulation for Nigerian market launch with unified balance classification breakdown (Withdrawable, Non-withdrawable, Earned, Deposited, Promotional, Pending Review).
7. Attach data-testid attributes to ALL interactive elements for seamless automated validation.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic centered layouts and standard blue gradients. Maintain deep executive sports console visual weight.
Every container with borders MUST have internal padding (p-4 to p-8) to prevent text collision.
Hover states must explicitly state text color (e.g. hover:bg-emerald-500 hover:text-slate-950).
Use lucide-react icons instead of emojis.
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.
